cards.title: Starting Token Cues Unlock Base-Model Reasoning Without RL Fine-Tuning
cards.why_it_matters: This reframes how we think about what RL post-training actually does — critical for anyone working on RLHF, reasoning models, or understanding emergent capabilities.
cards.summary: Fixing specific starting tokens ('Okay', 'Alright,') makes base models competitive with their RL-trained counterparts: on MATH-500, the cue '.\n\nOkay' raises OLMo-3-7B from 42% to 78%, and 'Alright,' raises Qwen3-14B from 72% to 87%. Causal data interventions show arbitrary words (e.g., 'chicken') become effective reasoning cues via targeted training-data edits; RL primarily raises these cues' probability.

cards.title: Probing Diffusion Transformer Text Tokens Reveals Early, Rich Scene Representations
cards.why_it_matters: For researchers in interpretability or generative models, this is direct mechanistic evidence for what MM-DiT contextual tokens encode and a practical handle for improving generation quality.
cards.summary: A lightweight bottleneck network maps MM-DiT intermediate contextual tokens into a frozen LLM's input space, enabling natural-language interrogation of hidden states. Generation-specific semantics are readable surprisingly early in denoising; information remains decodable even with an empty prompt. Generations with more readable contextual representations score higher on human-preference metrics. A derived training technique, Contextual Alignment, reinforces visual-semantic encoding and improves generation quality and distributional coverage.

cards.title: Agentic Pipeline Reformats ML Flowcharts Across Aspect Ratios Without Hallucinating Edges
cards.why_it_matters: If you ever repurpose paper figures for slides or posters, this directly addresses the broken-connection problem that plagues automated layout tools.
cards.summary: Parse→Style→Layout agentic pipeline with paired critic agents (deterministic constraint checks + VLM visual feedback) reformats raster flowcharts to arbitrary aspect ratios, outputting editable mxGraph XML. On 100-flowchart benchmark across five ratios, achieves 68.6% Content Fidelity vs. 11.2–41.4% for prior approaches, evaluated by Gemini 3.1 Pro and validated against human judgments.

cards.title: BiasFlow: Geometric Backbone Diagnostics and Regularization Reduce Spurious Feature Reliance
cards.why_it_matters: For researchers working on robustness or fairness, BiasFlow offers principled centroid-geometry diagnostics that WGA alone cannot provide, with concrete WGA gains on standard benchmarks.
cards.summary: BiasFlow is a hook-based toolkit measuring class-attribute centroid alignment (IBMI), within-class centroid separation (W-IBMI), and feature-projection sensitivity. Paired regularizer BFR adds a centroid-alignment penalty; on UrbanCars it improves worst-group accuracy by up to +26.0 pp. Freezing CelebA-Std backbones and retraining heads: BFR+GroupDRO raises WGA from 40.7% to 64.1% while reducing Male probe accuracy from 92.5% to 72.2%, though attribute information remains partially recoverable.
